answer: Entry requires a sponsor bond: an established identity stakes 51 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must therefore buy 8 sponsors per fake or post the bond itself, turning every alias into a 51-POA liability instead of a free account. The lagoon is the check that cannot be faked, the opal is the price the attacker pays, and the whisper is the record that outlives the epoch.
